530af07d76314fc828fc32512dc1225e.overview: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred. Eventually, Maximus is forced to become a gladiator and battle to the death against other men for the amusement of paying audiences.
530af07d76314fc828fc32512dc1225e.tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.

531b0513376d420d1fe32e250e48d601.overview: A 59-year-old carpenter recovering from a heart attack befriends a single mother and her two kids as they navigate the impersonal, Kafkaesque benefits system. With equal amounts of humour, warmth and despair, the journey is heartfelt and emotional until the end.
531b0513376d420d1fe32e250e48d601.tagline: My name is Daniel Blake. I am a man, not a dog.

533501f7afdffa3e5ffdae61261f2cc0.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.
533501f7afdffa3e5ffdae61261f2cc0.tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.

53495667fd8a6db9b88cd99355a0e698.overview: A semi-fictionalized account of the life of Mata Hari, an exotic dancer who was accused of spying for Germany during World War I.
53495667fd8a6db9b88cd99355a0e698.tagline: Men worshipped her like a goddess, only to be betrayed by a kiss!

5360cd8fe68e9677537c18a9fecdca98.overview: A white man trades with the Comanche for the release of a female stranger and the pair cross paths with three outlaws who have their eyes on the handsome reward for bringing her home and Comanche on the warpath.
5360cd8fe68e9677537c18a9fecdca98.tagline: The One-Man War Against The Comancheros!

53782439482924e9afba56bc206e1e9e.overview: The life of the revered 18th-century Armenian poet and musician Sayat-Nova. Portraying events in the life of the artist from childhood up to his death, the movie addresses in particular his relationships with women, including his muse. The production tells Sayat-Nova's dramatic story by using both his poems and largely still camerawork, creating a work hailed as revolutionary by Mikhail Vartanov.
53782439482924e9afba56bc206e1e9e.tagline: A poetic evocation of the life of Armenian poet Sayat Nova.

538d2547f88ddeff33d99e7f567852c5.overview: Guido Anselmi, a film director, finds himself creatively barren at the peak of his career. Urged by his doctors to rest, Anselmi heads for a luxurious resort, but a sorry group gathers—his producer, staff, actors, wife, mistress, and relatives—each one begging him to get on with the show. In retreat from their dependency, he fantasizes about past women and dreams of his childhood.
538d2547f88ddeff33d99e7f567852c5.tagline: A picture that goes beyond what men think about - because no man ever thought about it in quite this way!

53cfebeb46247f2cd829b52ce9d0d293.overview: Where does voguing come from, and what, exactly, is throwing shade? This landmark documentary provides a vibrant snapshot of the 1980s through the eyes of New York City's African American and Latinx Harlem drag-ball scene. Made over seven years, PARIS IS BURNING offers an intimate portrait of rival fashion "houses," from fierce contests for trophies to house mothers offering sustenance in a world rampant with homophobia, transphobia, racism, AIDS, and poverty. Featuring legendary voguers, drag queens, and trans women — including Willi Ninja, Pepper LaBeija, Dorian Corey, and Venus Xtravaganza.
53cfebeb46247f2cd829b52ce9d0d293.tagline: Having a ball… Wish you were here

53e2cfbc4d0d24fbfe7725a64410a009.overview: A quintet of cabbies in five cities and their remarkable fares on the same eventful night.
53e2cfbc4d0d24fbfe7725a64410a009.tagline: Five taxis. Five cities. One night.

53f9fd90bdaa9e9b31619b67cabbc0a4.overview: After his brother was crippled in the ring by a cheating Thai boxer,  Chan Hung goes to Thailand to avenge him, and finds the key to an omen which may release their family from an ancient curse. He is then caught up in a spiraling web of fate, Buddhist curses, and black magic.
53f9fd90bdaa9e9b31619b67cabbc0a4.tagline: Mysterious! Intriguing! Horrifying! Don't miss it!
